messages:
zoe: quick thread  need the canonical changelog + final docs URL for the Monday announcement. can eng confirm rollout window?
miguel: targeting 2026-09-07 10:00 UTC canary, 10:20 full for hosted. no infra conflicts.
tara: webinar at 11:00 UTC; marketing needs docs link by 10:30 to update slides and the CTA.
miguel: changelog snippet (please use verbatim in the post):
```
RWD-Infer v2.9.0 (2026-09-07)
- New adaptive batching policy for short-heavy traffic, reduces p95 tail
- INT8 kernel improvements for cost-sensitive workloads
- Faster KV warmup for multi-tenant sessions
- Stream resume and stability fixes
```
zoe: nice. can we include a short rollback line that's customer-facing? something concise.
miguel: suggest: "If issues arise, we fallback to rwd-infer-2.8.x with automated traffic cutover (minutes)." ops will run probes at canary start.
deploy-bot: Canary channel created: #deploy-1977654321-canary  will post hooks and health checks.
docs-bot: preview published at https://docs.redwood.ai/release/preview/2-9-0. final permalink will be https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/rwd-infer-2.9.0 once live.
zoe: inbound lead routing: registrants flagged release-sept7 -> route to SDR-G. sdr-team, confirm webhook fields?
sdr-team: confirmed: campaign=sept7-release, source=webinar-cta, tag=release-sept7. mapping posted to #integrations.
zoe: marketing blurb: "reduced p95 tail latency on short-heavy workloads"  eng wants qualifier?
miguel: use: "reduced p95 tail latency on our short-heavy workload benchmark". ok to publish.
zoe: checklist: miguel confirm deploy times (done); docs-bot publish permalink (pending); sdr-team mapping (done); deploy-bot/ops probes (pending); zoe send announcement T-10m.
miguel: infra will post T-30 and T-5 in the canary channel. i'll standby for rollback if smoke fails.
zoe: thanks all, scheduling 09:30 UTC preflight call. ping here if anything changes :rocket:
